title: Surreal Clock Tower Scene
description: A person sees a tall brown clock tower standing on a hill in the center of a giant circular clock face that forms a tunnel through green hills. The tower has two visible clock faces with hands, and a winding path marked with painted numbers leads from the bottom of the image up to the tower while a starry sphere hangs in the sky above it.
prompt: A tall brown clock tower with two clock faces stands on a hill inside a giant circular clock that creates a tunnel through rolling green hills. A winding dirt path marked with painted numbers leads from the foreground up to the tower. Above the tower floats a large starry sphere with a yellow glow and clouds in a teal sky with a crescent moon and small flying objects. The entire scene is framed as a finished surreal artwork.
